description: Reimplementing Git in Rust. Like a boss
notes: 'grit' is a drop-in-style Git implementation: the shim is added to PATH, so run 'grit status', 'grit clone <url>' and friends from any shell.

Shell completions ship in 'completions\' inside the app directory ('grit.ps1', '_grit', 'grit.bash', 'grit.fish'); load them by hand if you need them. This manifest does not touch your PowerShell profile.
grit has no built-in updater and no run-at-login hook, so nothing is registered with Windows startup and nothing replaces the Scoop-managed files. Update with 'scoop update grit'.
